instruction: I am compiling a dataset about the hosting countries of three machine learning conferences (ICLR, ICML, Neurips) from 2013 to 2019. I have prepared a spreadsheet with conference names and years. Please research and fill in the country name for each conference location in the City column.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
